modes.when: the pushed file is a whole document, or --plain is passed
modes.gets: client.js only; the document keeps its own styling and fonts. Put data-vc-components on <html> to also load components.css and the element module: the vc-* classes and elements then work, scoped, and your own CSS wins any collision. The value picks the palette: light (default), dark, or auto (follow the OS). Isolated previews (compare, states, --isolate) get the stylesheet only, never scripts.

entries.what: laid-out diagram from a short text source whose first line names the kind (flow, tree, sequence, state; flow when omitted) or from authored SVG; select a node to explore what feeds it or what it feeds, and a tab or term lights its nodes

entries.children: text source, first line the kind. Edge kinds: @default, @emphasis, @return, @async, @security. flow: `a[A] --> b(B)`, `-.->`, `-->|label|`, kind before the destination as in `a -->|label| @return b`. tree: indented `id[Label]` lines (a child is indented deeper than its parent), or `parent --> child` with the same label and kind forms; one parent per node, no cycles. sequence: optional `participant id` or `participant id as Label`, then in time order `a -> b: text` request, `b --> a: text` return, `a ->> b: text` async, or `a -> b: @security text` for another kind; participants are the nodes. state: `[*] --> id` initial, `id --> [*]` terminal, `id --> id: label` or `id -->|label| id` transition; a self-loop is valid only here. Authored SVG: nodes carry data-node, edges data-from, data-to and optional data-kind
